mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag (name, use_count) VALUES (#{name}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE use_count = use_count + 1
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tag WHERE name = #{name}
select name, use_count from tag force index (idx_use_count) order by use_count desc limit 20
